problem: Monitoring industrial processes with video and audio ML is costly when done purely in the cloud.
business_model: Turn-key edge plus multi-cloud AI solutions (anomaly detection, asset tracking, workforce management); pricing not found

technical_complexity.rationale: Claimed distributed edge plus multi-cloud ML on video and audio sensor data with a team of 3 in 2018.

defensibility.rationale: No evidence of data lock-in or customers; the edge/cloud split claim was the only differentiator listed.

market_need_then: Not independently sourced; the company asserts 100x lower operating cost and 1000x more data than cloud-only systems.
outcome_analysis: The YC directory lists numericcal as inactive, but no public post-mortem, acquisition or funding information could be found, and the company website was unavailable. The cause of the stall cannot be determined from sources, so no failure factors are asserted.
notes: Directory status Inactive but exit type left unknown (no source on shutdown). numericcal.com returned 503. Searches returned unrelated results. Founder bios unavailable.
